subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision extend the existing audit/task/artifact foundations, or become a separate subagent-specific ledger and API?
rationale: The remaining work defines a durable public contract for persisted data shape, security scope, redaction, retention, idempotency, and operator semantics, so automation should not choose that boundary alone.

options.title: Extend Existing Foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the current metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and subagent registry data.

options.title: Create Subagent Ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent event/control table and API, accepting another durable source of truth for this operator workflow.

options.title: Defer Durable Receipts
options.body: Leave current audit.list, tasks, artifacts, and subagent commands as separate operator tools and decline the lifecycle receipt contract for now.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the current metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and subagent registry data.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the persisted state, audit, terminal-state, and subagent runtime surfaces involved in this contract choice.
